set.body:
Diagnose and repair the Linux/x64 CompactConditionRuntimeSuite synthetic-cohort admission failure without changing its scientific contract. Exact authenticated PR20/PR21 logs show 21/24 admitted, below the unchanged >=0.9*24 threshold (minimum22). Current MacARM64 matching Node24.21 gives22/24; JVM gives24/24. Current source is identical to the historical fixture and decoder; local passing tests do not resolve Linux qualification.

Evidence is retained under docs/verification/main-reconciliation-readiness-20261006. TMP-only Darwin traces identify refused voxels4/15 as CandidateAttemptCap, current rawNewton corrections~1.7e-9/~7.7e-9, and full-Newton candidates with near-zero full-jet gradients but evaluated energy rises2ULP/1ULP. This is evidence of roundoff-sensitive terminal descent checks, not proof that the stored binary64 candidate designs genuinely descend.

Required next step: capture failed Linux voxel IDs, current/candidate coordinates, energies/ULPs, gradients,Hessians,rawcorrections,predictedgains,amplitudes and counters on the exact hosted runtime (Ubuntu24.04 x64, Temurin17.0.20-1, Node24.21). Independently refit stored designs at high precision and distinguish subtraction error from kernel/design rounding or genuine uphill movement. The archived UnresolvableDecrease proposal is not admitted: sqrt(1e-9) stationarity and halfULP(E) depend on additive objective offsets and relax the current1e-9 criterion.

Acceptance: preserve cohort and >=22/24 admission,0.02 latency,0.05relativeSD,0.002relativeamplitude and6Newton/8jets/2exact/90nodes limits, identification/boundary semantics and coherent terminal jets. Qualify any precision repair with independent paired-decrease/MP witnesses and counterexamples (constant-offset quadratics,incoherent callbacks,true uphill/nonstationary plateaus,coupled constraints,priors), JVM+JS and exact Linux/x64 gate. Never make the existing CI assertion looser or accept the archived policy merely because it passes the cohort. This blocks normal main publication while the required check remains red. No decoder change was made during current audit.
set.title: Diagnose Linux/x64 compact-condition cohort admission and terminal descent precision
